visual.description: Two vertical bars side-by-side: H&M Regular Collection (61%, Accent Blue) and H&M Conscious Collection (72%, Accent Pink). The Conscious bar is taller — the irony is the visual punchline. Title: 'H&M Synthetic Content' in Montserrat. A small annotation arrow or label: 'sustainability line has MORE synthetic' in Warm Cream below. Bars grow with spring stagger (6-frame delay).

notes: Key irony moment — Conscious Collection bar should visually exceed Regular. Use Accent Pink for Conscious to draw attention to the higher (worse) bar. Annotation text appears after both bars complete their animation.
